title: Weighted reconstruction sum
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$, and let $f$ assign an element of $F$ to each member of $A$. The recombined value is the sum over $i\in A$ of $f(i)$ weighted by the recombination coefficient of $i$ in $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero elements of $F$
$f$ assigns an element of $F$ to each member of $A$
caveat: The provided snippet does not define the recombination coefficients, so their meaning beyond their role as weights cannot be specified from the ground truth.
